steps: Calculate only the master's credits exceeding 24 credits; recognition is capped at 12 credits.
Only 6 thesis-research credits may count in the calculation. Subtract any thesis-research credits above 6 from the excess-credit total.

If your department does not count common-competency courses toward master's completion credits, exclude those credits when calculating the excess. Confirm whether this applies with ECE administration.
